key_facts: July 26 update (T+1d to res=2026-07-27; Day 1 Stumps / Day 2 start of 1st Test at Tarouba): UPDATED Jomel Warrican 0.22->0.26 (+0.04), Roston Chase 0.04->0.05 (+0.01), Jayden Seales 0.32->0.30 (-0.02), Shamar Joseph 0.27->0.26 (-0.01), Kemar Roach 0.13->0.11 (-0.02), sum=0.98 (Justin Greaves ~0.02 outside top 5). KEY DAY 1 STUMPS DEVELOPMENTS (KheloPakistan July 26, Khaleej Times July 25): (1) After rain wiped out 23 overs on Day 1, West Indies recovered from 23/1 to finish Day 1 strongly at 194/3 in 67 overs (Kavem Hodge 83*, Shai Hope 39*, with Greaves, Chase, Roach, Warrican, Shamar Joseph, Seales still to bat). (2) Pitch confirmed 'slow' and 'turgid' — Mohammad Abbas (2/44 in 19 ov) said 'This pitch is a bit slow... you have to work really hard to get wickets', and Day 2 is expected to offer even less to seamers. (3) Because WI are well placed to bat deep into Day 2 (targeting 350-400), Pakistan will bat under scoreboard pressure starting late Day 2 / Day 3 (and again Day 4-5) on a drier, wearing surface. This boosts sole specialist spinner Jomel Warrican (massive expected workload + 19 wkts vs PAK in 2025) and part-time off-spinner Roston Chase, while reducing veteran medium-pacer Kemar Roach. Seales (home ground, reverse swing, #1 strike bowler) remains narrow #1 at 0.30 and express pacer Shamar Joseph (firepower on a turgid track) holds co-#2 at 0.26.
